An [[Iridonian]] [[Zabrak]] [[Gender|male]] was a '''fighter''' in a [[Sorgan Common House|common house]] on [[Sorgan]]. In [[9 ABY]], he fought the former [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebel]] [[shock trooper]] [[Carasynthia Dune]], who defeated him by making him tap out the [[Laser Tether]] that connected the two fighters.

==Biography==
[[File:Dune-Fight-TMS1C7.jpg|thumb|left|270px|The Zabrak brawling Cara Dune for credits.]]
In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date Note">{{MandoDate|7}}</ref> the [[Gender|male]] [[Zabrak]] fought [[Carasynthia Dune]] in a [[Sorgan Common House|common house]] on [[Sorgan]] in an attempt to earn [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] betted on his victory, connected to her by a tether. Initially gaining the upper hand in the brawl, he knocked Dune into the bar's counter, but was quickly countered by the former [[shock trooper]]. The Zabrak then pulled the tether in an attempt to close their distance. Dune used the opportunity to pull the fighter off-balance, and won the fight by strangling him with the tether until he tapped out. Following the match, he left his credits on her table while she spoke with [[Din Djarin]], with Dune telling him to come back soon.<ref name="Chapter 7" />

==Personality and traits==
The Iridonian Zabrak fighter was a male with [[Color|orange]] skin and blue eyes.<ref name="Chapter 7" />

==Skills and abilities==
While fighting Cara Dune, he initially gained the upper hand, but was eventually overpowered and lost the fight.<ref name="Chapter 7" />

==Equipment==
The Zabrak wore a [[Limb|sleeveless]] [[Clothing|vest]] over a striped gray shirt, as well as fingerless [[glove]]s and brown pants.<ref name="Chapter 7" />

==Behind the scenes==
The fighter was portrayed by [[Dave Reaves]] in [[Chapter 7: The Reckoning|Chapter 7]] of the [[2019]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'',<ref name="Chapter 7" /> which aired on [[December 18]], 2019.<ref name="DTCI">{{WebCite|url=https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/documents/the_mandalorian_project_one-sheet_10_ec1e005f.pdf|text=The Mandalorian Media Kit|work=[https://dtcimedia.disney.com Disney Direct-to-Consumer & International]|archivedate=20230315011507}}</ref>
